name: Bitpanda Group AG
via: holding company of the Bitpanda group
note: Holding company of the Vienna-based Bitpanda group (Trending Topics, 19 Mar 2026). Its supervisory board includes founders Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer; Valar Ventures led the 2021 funding round, with partners from DST Global (TechCrunch, 15 Mar 2021).
